newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Somague in pole position for dam project.
newsitem.headline: Somague in pole position for dam project.

text.p: A Portuguese-Spanish consortium led by Somague-Sociedade de Construcoes has won in principle a contract for the building of the Alqueva hydro-electric dam on the river Guadiana, the Alqueva Development and Infrastructure Company (EDIA) said on Thursday.
The consortium, composed of Bento Pedroso Construcoes, Cubiertas & Mzov and Dragados & Construcciones bid 16 billion escudos for the building work.
Rival consortia now have 10 days to dispute the decision of a special commission appointed by EDIA to evaluate the bids.
Seven consortia had competed for the project. Building work is expected to started in the second half of 1997 and take a maximum of 62 months.
